# Pohjola — LLM / agent quick reference

> PureScript 0.15.16 + Bun SSR MPA + Alpine.js. DaisyUI 5 is the visual vocabulary.

## Do

- Fill `App.Ui.Templates` slots via `renderPage lang route status (Landing|Hub|Editorial|Feed|Article|Schedule|Form …)`.
- Put copy in `Data.I18n` for every `allLangs` (En, Fr, Pt). Put metadata in `Data.Content`.
- Build HTML only through `App.Html`. Interactivity only through `App.Alpine`.
- Run `make gate` before claiming UI work is done; `make check` before commit.
- After a convention change, run the matching eval with `CHECK=1` (`make eval EVAL=12-add-ui-component CHECK=1`).

## Do not

- Call `class_` or assemble DaisyUI/Tailwind strings in `App.Features/*/View.purs` or `Components/`.
- Import `App.Ui.Card`, `Container`, `Prose`, `Alert`, `Badge`, `Form`, … from feature views.
- Invent layout: copy the exemplar for the page purpose (Home/About/Contact/Posts/Fixtures).
- Maintain a parallel React/shadcn/Next app or JSON registry for production UI.
- Serve `dist-server/` from the public static root (`dist/` only).
- Implement ADR-010 or wire `App.Auth.Scaffold` into Main/Features.

## Page → template

| Purpose | `PageTemplate` | Exemplar |
|---|---|---|
| Landing | `Landing` | `Home/View.purs` |
| Hub / links | `Hub` | `Contact/View.purs` |
| Editorial | `Editorial` | `About/View.purs` |
| Feed / list | `Feed` | `Posts/View.purs` (list) |
| Article | `Article` | `Posts/View.purs` (detail) |
| Match list / calendar | `Schedule` | `Fixtures/View.purs` |
| Signup / contact form | `Form` | template-only (no feature exemplar yet) |

Markers: `App.Ui.Templates.Contract` (`data-template="…"`). Tests: `TemplateContractSpec`, `ShellSpec`, `PolicySpec`.

## Where classes live

- Primitives: `App.Ui.Alert`, `Avatar`, `Badge`, `Breadcrumbs`, `Button`, `Card`, `Container`, `Divider`, `EmptyState`, `Form`, `Prose`, `Stat`, `TextTone` (DaisyUI 1:1). There is no `App.Ui.Hero` — landing hero is `LandingHeroSlots`.
- Page chrome + sections: `App.Ui.Templates.*` (SiteShell, Landing, Editorial, Hub, Feed, Article, Schedule, Form).
- Site nav/theme chrome: `SiteShell.purs` only; use `navLink` + `navLinkClasses` (`docs/conventions/chrome-checklist.md`).
- DaisyUI primitives: `App.Ui.*` + Templates only — `docs/conventions/component-checklist.md`; coverage: `make ui-coverage`.
- DaisyUI reference: `vendor/daisyui/skills/daisyui/components/` (git submodule — `make deps`).
- Themes: `css/input.css` (`@plugin "daisyui"` + `pohjola` / `pohjola-dark`, primary `#047857`).

## Full agent guide

See `AGENTS.md`, `docs/conventions/design-system.md`, ADR-012.
